messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: hosted-api-us-west p99 latency spike > 5s and request_queue_length > 12k. autoscaler events: scale_error x3. Paging oncall.
Amanda Chen: on it. seeing p95 ~1.8s earlier, now p95=3.2s, p99=7.6s. queue growth steady for last 7m.
Raj Patel: looking at autoscaler: provisioner requests returning 429 from cloud provider. logs: 
```
provisioner: create_instance failed: rateLimitExceeded
autoscaler: desired_replicas=180 current=120 max_allowed=180
```
Feels like we've hit soft quota + provisioner rate limit combined.
Cassie Li: are we hitting internal max_replicas? dashboard shows max_replicas=180 for hosted-prod-usw. If provisioner is rate-limiting, we won't hit that safely.
Mike (oncall): I can temporarily raise max_replicas if infra thinks it's safe, but provisioner will still be throttled. suggest immediate traffic shedding + model-fallback to keep tail latencies down.
Amanda Chen: agreed. Let's enable circuit-breaker: start shedding non-critical long requests and route large token requests to fallback-lite model. Also enable request-level concurrency cap per client.
infra-bot: Proposed mitigation commands:
```
rctl set autoscaler hosted-prod-usw --max-replicas=260 --reason="incident 3698765432 temporary bump"
rctl apply policy hosted-prod-usw --circuit-breaker=enabled --latency-threshold=2000
```
Raj Patel: running the apply now. watch logs.
Amanda Chen: also enabling fallback routing for models: route model=redwood-xl -> redwood-xl-quant-fallback for requests > 512 tokens.
Cassie Li: can we enable prefix/KV cache warmup on the fallback to prevent cold-start latency?
Raj Patel: yes, triggering kv-cache preload for common prompts: `kvpreload --pool hosted-prod-usw --keys common_prompt_set`
Mike (oncall): notifying Customer Success: one enterprise customer (acct: blueco) reported timeouts, flagging them with ETA for mitigation. @Customer Success please escalate if they need immediate manual throttling. :loudspeaker:
Customer Success: acknowledged. Reached out to the account, offered temporary rate-limit increase on their dedicated plan or route to dedicated capacity. They're ok for now but want updates.
infra-bot: Provisioner logs after bump attempt:
```
[2026-03-15T04:12:05Z] provisioner: request create vm id=abc123 status=429 reason=RATE_LIMIT
[2026-03-15T04:13:11Z] provisioner: backoff sleeping 30s
[2026-03-15T04:14:40Z] autoscaler: attempted scale to 200, applied 0 due to provisioner failure
```
Raj Patel: provisioner still returning 429s but backoff windows moving us forward slowly. queue growth paused after circuit-breaker enabled but p99 still high for long-running requests.
Amanda Chen: starting an emergency evict of queued requests over 90s age for public tier to free slots. command: `queuectl evict --age 90 --scope public`
Cassie Li: enabling model-level token cap for public tier: `max_input_tokens=512` and reducing max_output_tokens to 256 for generation endpoints to reduce compute per-request.
Mike (oncall): rolling handoff to night oncall (Eva) in 30m with summary. I'll stay until backlog shows sustained decline.
Eva Ramos: taking handoff in 30. pls post runbook notes.
Amanda Chen: runbook summary:
- root cause: provisioner rate-limited by cloud provider while traffic spike hit hosted API; autoscaler desired_replicas exceeded provider throughput -> scale deadlock
- immediate mitigations applied: bump max_replicas (temporary), enabled circuit-breaker to shed long requests, evicted aged queued requests, enabled model-fallback to quantized lighter variant, limited tokens for public tier, KV cache preload
- commands run: see infra-bot block above + `queuectl evict` + `rctl set autoscaler` + `kvpreload`
Raj Patel: monitoring metrics: queue_length peaked ~12.6k -> down to 3.1k after mitigations; request_accept_rate trending up slowly. p99 dropped from 7.6s -> 2.9s after circuit-breaker and evictions.
Cassie Li: still see a small spike in errors 502 for a subset of clients that were mid-request when we evicted. collecting request ids for CS to triage.
Customer Success: collecting impacted request ids and customer manifests. flagging one high-SLO customer for remediation.
Mike (oncall): adding temporary post-incident note: notify cloud provider support about rate-limit behavior and request quota bump. We should also add provider-side exponential backoff jitter to provisioner.
infra-bot: created ticket PROV-4523 with provider support and attached logs.
Amanda Chen: action items for follow-up:
- infra: add more graceful degrade path in autoscaler to avoid deadlock when provisioner throttles (Raj/Cassie)
- runtime: test and document fallback routing to quantized models (Amanda)
- oncall: improve alerting to separate queue growth due to traffic vs due to provisioner errors (Mike/Eva)
- cs: compile list of impacted customers and outreach notes (Customer Success)
Eva Ramos: taking over monitoring. will keep this channel updated every 15m until green. handing off to SRE rotation with notes attached.
Amanda Chen: thanks everyone. closing paging escalation when metrics stable for 30m. :white_check_mark:
Eva Ramos: 15m check-in: queue_length=1.2k, p99=1.1s, provisioner error rate reduced to 0.8%. continuing watch.
